Senior Backend Engineer
Oakline Software · Remote - US

Oakline Software builds scheduling tools for clinics and small hospitals. Our platform team owns the APIs that thousands of front desks rely on every morning, and we are hiring a senior engineer to help us scale them.

What you'll do
- Design and run Go services on Kubernetes in AWS
- Own our PostgreSQL schema and migrations
- Improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana
- Mentor two mid-level engineers

Requirements
- 5+ years building backend services in Go or Java
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL experience
- Experience running services on Kubernetes and Docker
- Comfortable with REST APIs and gRPC
- Clear written communication; we are a distributed team

Nice to have
- Terraform
- Kafka or another event streaming system
- Experience with HIPAA

Benefits
- Fully remote, with a yearly team week
- 401(k) with a 4% match
- Home office stipend

Oakline Software is an equal opportunity employer.
